To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the implicit-gemm and the winograd convolutional implementations are too slow to be used in a production environment.

• the implicit gemm algorithm can be used to accelerate the convolutional layers in cltorch • the implicit gemmm algorithm is faster than the standard convolutional algorithm for small convolutional filters (e.g. 3x3, 5x5) • the implicit gemmg algorithm is slower than the standard convolution for large convolutional filters (9x9, 11x11) • the implicitgemm implementation can be used to obtain hardware-agnostic performance on GPUs from diverse vendors •

1) cltorch is a hardware-agnostic deep learning framework based on OpenCL, 2) cltorch is the current top ranked hardwareagnostic framework on Chintalas benchmark page, and 3) we identify the convolutional layer as the bottleneck in a hardware-agnostic framework. 4/2016 1
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: • What are the key challenges associated with obtaining a hardware-agnostic implementation of the convolutional layers?
the development of a fast, hardware-agnostic convolutional layer implementation for use in a deep learning framework.
the development of a hardware-agnostic implementation of the Torch deep learning framework.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is no single approach that can provide a fast hardware-agnostic implementation.
the implicit gemm algorithm is the fastest approach for a hardware-agnostic convolution implementation.

the convolutional layers are the most important area of focus for a hardware-agnostic framework and that the best approach for accelerating convolutional layers is to implement the convolutional layer in a way that is hardware-specific.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have implemented a convolutional algorithm that is hardwareagnostic and that is competitive with hardware-specific implementations.
cltorch is the first hardware-agnostic deep learning framework that is able to run the same models on diverse hardware.

cltorch is a hardware-agnostic implementation of the Torch deep learning library, based on OpenCL. cltorch enables the training of deep neural network models on a wide variety of GPUs, including AMD, Intel, and NVIDIA GPUs, and can be extended to other GPUs.
The main takeaway from our work is that

a hardware-agnostic framework such as cltorch can obtain performance competitive with vendor-specific frameworks such as cuDNN and MKL-DNN, by using a combination of the implicit gemm algorithm and pluggable hardwarespecific convolutional implementations.
the convolutional implementation is the key area for performance optimisation.
a hardware-agnostic framework is possible, and is competitive with vendor-specific frameworks.
